description: List all subscriber lists. Each list includes subscriberCount (current members of any status) and activeSubscriberCount (current members with status=active). Members who unsubscribed from the list are not counted. Use these fields for list audience size instead of paging search_subscribers.

companyId.description: Company ID to list lists for. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: list_lists

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_lists` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

lists.description: Subscriber lists. Each entry includes id, name, description, isPrivate, allowMemberUnsubscribe, createdAt, subscriberCount (current members of any status), and activeSubscriberCount (current members with status=active). Memberships with unsubscribedAt set are excluded.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
